sections.label: FES Report
body: Friedrich Ebert Stiftung India asked us to turn an international conference into a publication people would keep. India, EU & Just Energy Transitions: Strengthening Climate Diplomacy for Sustainable Futures was organised by the Manipal Academy of Higher Education with FES, in association with UNESCO, and brought together policymakers, academics and civil society on India–EU cooperation, carbon neutrality and just transitions.
FES India provided the base content. Studio 1947 took it from raw proceedings to a finished report: concept and direction, the illustration system, layout, and print production.

media.alt: Two copies of the India, EU and Just Energy Transitions report fanned open on a pink-to-blue gradient, showing the front cover illustration and an inside recommendations spread
Close-up of the report open at the executive summary and the credits page, with orange watercolour illustrations on the facing page

sections.heading: The Report
body: The cover carries the whole argument in one image: two hands holding a green city, wired to wind, solar, hydro and a coal plant below, plugged into a handshake. Inside, the report is organised as numbered recommendations, from mobilising climate finance to ensuring equity and social responsibility, each opened with a full illustration so a busy reader can follow the structure by pictures alone.

media.alt: The report's blue back cover beside an open spread with orange watercolour speech-bubble illustrations
Front cover of India, EU and Just Energy Transitions: hands holding a green city wired to renewable and coal energy, with the Manipal, UNESCO and FES marks

body: Bidisha and Pragya drew the report in a loose watercolour-and-ink style, deliberately unlike the stock-photo look of most policy documents. Wind turbines, coal barrels bleeding red smoke, a mountain village, a market crowd: each image sits with its recommendation and names the place the policy is meant to reach.

media.alt: Programme agenda spread: an illustrated handshake of hands in different skin tones beside the red Programme Agenda page with UN Sustainable Development Goal icons
Spread showing recommendations 03 to 06 on mobilising climate finance, fostering just transitions, governance and equity, each with its own watercolour illustration

sections.heading: Also for FES India: Artificial Intelligence in India
body: The report sits within a longer relationship. Since 2019 Rabi has designed FES India's Artificial Intelligence in India paper series: twelve volumes on AI and democracy, governance, education, sustainability, cities and ports, held together by one cover system, a robotic hand offering a sphere, with a single line icon and a solid colour per volume.
